description: With `ref`: one work item’s live state, progress, latest result, what it is waiting for, and draft or publication state with links; `waitSeconds` waits up to 50 seconds. With `about` (a URL, path, Shopify GID, theme file or fudge:// ref): what has changed there, by `view` current, history or summary. `about: "fudge://store"` is the store-wide timeline.

about.description: Storefront URL/path, Shopify GID, theme file, fudge://discount/<key>, .projects/.plans path, or fudge://store for the whole store.

from.description: With view history: YYYY-MM-DD in store time, or an ISO timestamp.

ref.description: A work item to read: fudge://project/… or fudge://thread/….

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.

waitSeconds.description: With ref: wait up to this long for running work to finish or need the merchant. Default 0.

name: read_work
title: Read work
